theorems.name: Submission.isoperimetric_coord_covector_eval
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (α : SimonMultiIndex n N), (wedgeCovectors n (fun i => EuclideanSpace.proj (α i)) : Covector (Eucl N) n) (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (α j) (1 : ℝ)) = 1 ∧ (∀ α' : SimonMultiIndex n N, α' ≠ α → (wedgeCovectors n (fun i => EuclideanSpace.proj (α i)) : Covector (Eucl N) n) (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (α' j) (1 : ℝ)) = 0) ∧ ∀ c : ℝ, covectorEuclideanNorm (c • (wedgeCovectors n (fun i => EuclideanSpace.proj (α i)) : Covector (Eucl N) n)) = |c|
